experience.summary: Full stack developer building scalable applications
highlights: Built and deployed a multi-user RAG notes assistant (React, Node/Express, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search) with per-user retrieval filtering, streaming answers, Firebase Auth.

Integrated an LLM-powered chat assistant (OpenAI Responses API) behind a provider-agnostic wrapper. Hardened the assistant against prompt injection using layered instruction-level and mechanical controls, with server-side validation and sanitization of client-supplied conversation history
Workforce management dashboard supporting role-based access, employee directory, analytics & insights, project tracking.

experience.summary: Worked as an individual contributor, building scalable React and React Native applications across Airtel's digital platforms, developing reusable cross-vertical solutions, improving application performance, and delivering high-impact customer-facing experiences.
highlights: Built a shared location-capture and serviceability module adopted across Airtel verticals, eliminating duplicate builds and reducing GTM time by 35%
Developed a workflow management tool enabling multiple business verticals to manage customer milestones, reducing GTM turnaround time by 30%
Built a unified mobility onboarding journey for prepaid, postpaid, and broadband products, increasing customer footprint by 20%
Migrated a high-traffic Airtel Shop module to React Native, supporting 36.5K+ daily transactions and 15M+ monthly active users
Optimized application performance through bundle splitting and efficient rendering, reducing LCP by 32% and FCP by 21%
Implemented Firebase A/B testing to analyze user clicks and impressions, enabling data-driven product decisions

experience.summary: Delivered client-facing web platforms in a global digital consultancy, collaborating with client stakeholders across discovery, development, testing, and release cycles.
highlights: Designed, developed, tested, and maintained high-performance React applications while following engineering best practices and conducting peer code reviews
Resolved defects in a shared design system used across multiple business verticals, improving component stability and enabling reuse across partner teams

Built reusable and configurable UI components, including data tables, data views, complex charts, dynamic templates, forms, and card-based interfaces, accelerating feature development across applications
Collaborated with client stakeholders and cross-functional teams in an Agile delivery model to deliver scalable web solutions

experience.summary: Contributed to enterprise workflow automation and correspondence management products across government and banking domains, building responsive React applications, developing client-facing proof-of-concepts, and enhancing core product functionality.
highlights: Contributed to a core workflow automation product used across government and banking domains, supporting end-to-end process automation and improving operational efficiency
Developed React.js proof-of-concepts for major national and international client engagements, contributing to new business opportunities
Built responsive, cross-browser user interfaces for desktop, tablet, and mobile while following accessibility best practices
Maintained and enhanced CORMS (Correspondence Management System) across multiple modules, contributing to core product functionality and improvements

about: I'm Mayank, a senior frontend engineer who sits between design and engineering. I love taking a rough idea and turning it into an interface that feels instant, works for everyone, and is a pleasure to maintain.

principles.title: Users feel performance
principles.text: Every 100ms counts. I set budgets and measure real-user data, not just lab scores.

principles.title: Accessible from day one
principles.text: Keyboard, screen readers and contrast are part of done, not a later ticket.

principles.title: Components are products
principles.text: Good APIs, docs and examples make a design system something teams want to use.
